text:
Marta: Heads-up — RC cutoff in ~2 hours. Need: version bump merged, changelog entry, someone to push the annotated tag and create the draft GitHub release, and upload signed artifacts. Who's available? @devon @sam

Sam: Which repo & tag name are we using?

Marta: repo: inference-server (main). Target tag: v1.12.0-rc1. PR for bump is blocking the merge.

Devon: I opened the bump PR -> https://github.com/redwood/inference-server/pull/2345. CI is green but blocked on artifact upload step (needs release credentials). I can merge once the checksum/upload is ready.

Anna: I'll add the changelog entry now — short bullets for: model routing fallback fix, batched KV cache tweak, doc link. Will push to the PR branch.

ReleaseBot: CI pipeline succeeded (build, unit, integ). Artifacts available at: s3://builds/redwood/inference/1767778888/ (upload pending finalization). :white_check_mark:

Kai: For the annotated tag and draft release, we should use the same notes file. Proposed release notes file: RELEASE_NOTES/v1.12.0-rc1.md

Sam: I can run the checksum/upload step and finalize artifacts. After I upload I'll post the S3 path and SHA256 list here.

Devon: Thanks — once Sam posts SHAs I'll merge PR and push tag. Tag commands I'd use:
```
git tag -a v1.12.0-rc1 -m "release v1.12.0-rc1"
git push origin v1.12.0-rc1
```
And create draft release via GitHub CLI:
```
gh release create v1.12.0-rc1 --draft --title "v1.12.0-rc1" --notes-file RELEASE_NOTES/v1.12.0-rc1.md
```

Anna: I'll cross-check changelog items after merge. Sam — ping me when checksums are up so I can confirm asset names.

Sam: Uploaded checksums and artifacts: s3://releases/redwood/inference/v1.12.0-rc1/
SHA256s:
- inference-server-linux.tar.gz: abc12345f7c9d...
- inference-server-windows.zip: def67890b1a2c...

Devon: Merging PR now, will push annotated tag and draft release in ~5m. @Kai can you attach the build matrix screenshot to the draft?

Kai: Yep. Will attach and set the release to private draft. :thumbsup: 

Marta: Awesome — please drop the final GH release URL after it's created. If anything blocks, escalate here. Thanks all. :rocket:
